name: RTX A4000 Ollama 0.5.11: mistral:7b per-request eval rate
methodology: Database Mart Ollama 0.5.11 on one RTX A4000 16 GB GDDR6 (Windows VPS, 24 cores, 32 GB RAM). Default Ollama pull, labelled 4-bit, exact GGUF quant not printed, so format_id is null. Prompt is a single short question and the output length is model-determined, so this is the eval-rate column only: per-request decode, batch size 1, NOT aggregate and NOT a prefill rate. The llama.cpp commit inside Ollama 0.5.11 is not printed. Ollama tag mistral:7b. Reported GPU utilization 81%.
notes: Eval Rate (tokens/s) column. Per-request, not aggregate.
